coverage.text: Fall 2026 Mini-Midterm 1 (Wed 9/23, 8–9:20pm), given after lecture 12. This option assumes it covered lectures 1–12.

scope.note: Problems are included when every topic tagged on them was taught before Mini-Midterm 1. That classification is this site’s, not a staff recommendation.

noPicks: Course staff haven’t named practice questions here yet, so nothing is marked recommended.

timed.intro: Each exam draws past Midterm 1 problems at random. They aren’t modified, so you may have seen some of them already.
